nodes.label: WAT Framework (Workflows, Agents, Tools)
nodes.rationale: Separates probabilistic AI reasoning from deterministic code execution; compounding per-step error (90%^5 = 59%) makes offloading execution to scripts more reliable.

nodes.label: Self-Improvement Loop
nodes.rationale: Every failure: identify, fix tool, verify, update workflow, so the system hardens over time.
